rs/u/a stores one integer sample position/time, one value float, four tangent/control floats and a next-key pointer; its decoder reads exactly that record shape from the stream.

Its application methods evaluate animation curves for a time/frame value, compose rotation/translation/scale matrices and apply the result to rs/u/d bone records; Model consumes this path for skeletal animation.
